_doc: Quality grades of made goods and the craft skills that set them (core/grades.js, player/crafting.js, world/marketGrades.js). A held stack keeps plain qty in player.inventory; the units above or below Common are counted in player.craftGrades[good] = { poor, fine, excellent, masterwork } (Common is whatever is left). price: what a unit of the grade fetches and costs against a Common one. effect: how much more it does (nourishment, healing, protection, a weapon's cut, how long clothes stay fresh, how much tools help at the bench). below: the quality score under which a roll lands on this grade (the last has none).
_skills: Craft skills: each recipe in data/crafting.json names its `skill` (or takes its station's). Levels 0-10 live on player.skills like the other skills and rise with crafting xp (OddJobs.gainXp, x xpScale). titles: the name of a level band (the highest `min` not above the level).

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.desc: Smelting, forging tools, blades and armour

carpentry.name: Carpentry
carpentry.desc: Planks, joinery, barrels, bows, shields and arrows

tailoring.name: Tailoring
tailoring.desc: Spinning, weaving and sewing clothes and cloaks

leatherwork.name: Leatherwork
leatherwork.desc: Tanning, leather armour, boots, saddles and bookbinding

alchemy.name: Alchemy & Herbalism
alchemy.desc: Potions, salves, soap, candles and ink

_legacy: Old saves kept one crafting rank (player.crafting.xp): the first time a craft skill is read it starts at legacyPerRank x that rank.
_roll: A craft's quality score = base + level x perLevel + workshop (0, 1 or 1.2 in one you own) x workshop + tools x tools x the tools' power x their grade's effect + (attribute - 5) x perAttr - (difficulty - 1) x perDifficulty + the inputs' average grade above Common x perInputGrade + the forge minigame ((score - 50) / 50 x forge), plus a triangular noise of +-noise from the seeded RNG. The grade is the first whose `below` the score is under.
_tools: What counts as tools at the bench, and how much each helps (the best you carry is used; it wears by its grade: a Fine set lasts longer).
_wear: Goods worn on the body: the best grade held of a kind sets how much it does. clothing: freshness lost a day is divided by the grade's effect (player/core/needs.js).
_gradeable: Goods that come in grades: every product of a data/crafting.json recipe (unless the recipe says quality: false) plus these, which the towns' own trades make.
_market: The towns' craftsmanship (world/marketGrades.js): a level 0-10 = typeLevel + a fixed local knack (+-knack, by the town's name) + guild (a town guild that guards the good) + perWorksLevel x the level of the player's works making it. Its market stock comes in grades: poor = poorBase - poorPerLevel x level, fine = fineBase + finePerLevel x level, excellent = excellentPerLevel x (level - excellentFrom), masterwork = masterworkPerLevel x (level - masterworkFrom), shares of the stock (each at least 0); the stalls are restocked in grades every `restockDays`.

market._labels: The word for a town's craftsmanship (the highest `min` not above its level)

_soap: A cake of soap in the pack is used when you bathe or wash your clothes by hand (player/core/needs.js): this much more hygiene and clothes freshness, x its grade's effect.
_hired: Hired work (systems/commissions.js) comes out in the town's grades: its craftsmanship level for the product, with the trade's skill (a commission is not rolled: the shares are the market's mix, rounded down, the rest Common).
